comments.body: Does this steward differ to the average one in something?

comments.author: Hernan
comments.body: All stewards are the same in function. The only difference between them is their appearance; I picked her as my steward because I liked how she looked.

comments.author: Wim
comments.body:
The country of origin affects the food they offer. In Sophia's case, the same food you find in French taverns.
Other than that, and appearance, they are the same.
